localizedDescriptions.en: Review connected social channels and work with posts scheduled in Postiz.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 查看 Postiz 已连接的社交渠道，并管理排期中的帖子。

en: List my connected social channels and show which posts are scheduled for the next seven days.
zh-CN: 列出我已连接的社交渠道，并查看未来七天的帖子排期。

instructions.en: In Postiz Cloud, go to Settings → Developers and copy your API key into the plugin settings. Postiz documents this setting for Standard plans and above.
instructions.zh-CN: 在 Postiz Cloud 的「设置 → 开发者」中复制 API Key，再填入插件设置。根据 Postiz 文档，开发者设置适用于 Standard 及以上套餐。
